description: Pair two existing compatible apps on this account in different reported countries. Managed countries come from internal inventory; an external country is declared by the customer and is not verified by Impreza. Deploy scope. Does not provision servers, copy data or switch traffic. First create the reviewed catalog standby with impreza_deploy_catalog_app and standby:true, without domain or onion. The standby must have no public route or onion. Standby pairing requires a hostname in the managed zone. A primary with only a .onion address cannot be paired yet. A database pairing requires the database-failover API gate, a dedicated owned provider on each side, PostgreSQL PITR or a consistent MariaDB dump, and declared rpo_seconds (300–3600). The first verified drill opts into minute refreshes; failures pause them. No zero-loss promise. Private onion services remain unsupported. Hosted MCP requires an account credential without resource confinement.
name: impreza_pair_failover_standby
title: Pair a cold standby
